name: io.github.OWNER/ddflow
title: ddflow
description: Work-queue kernel for AI coding agents: phases and tasks with dependencies, parallel git-worktree isolation, crash recovery, a quality-gate pipeline, and cross-family review. The event log is the source of truth, so the project rebuilds from it alone.

environmentVariables.name: DDFLOW_REPO
environmentVariables.description: Repository root ddflow manages. Defaults to the client's working directory, resolved to the primary checkout even when called from inside a git worktree.

environmentVariables.name: DDFLOW_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Stable identity for this agent process. Shards the event log so concurrent agents never write the same file. Defaults to host-pid.
